title: Feta & Chicken Pasta Bake
summary: Chicken breasts bake with cherry tomatoes, feta and garlic, then get shredded into the sauce and mixed with pasta. Finish with basil and Parmesan and bake for another 5 minutes; the creator's written recipe serves 4.

ingredients.note: The reviewer's voiceover says he uses protein pasta; the written recipe says pasta.

steps.text: Put the cherry tomatoes, block of feta, chicken breasts, olive oil, salt, black pepper, smoked paprika and garlic in a large baking dish.
Bake at 200 °C fan for 35 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through.
Meanwhile, boil the pasta until tender, then drain.
Take out the garlic and squeeze the roasted garlic from its cloves into the dish.
Shred the chicken with a fork and mix it with the tomatoes, feta and roasted garlic.
Add the cooked pasta and mix everything together.
Top with basil and Parmesan, then return to the oven for another 5 minutes.

nutrition.note: Creator-reported figures from the description; not independently calculated. The reviewer uses protein pasta, while the written ingredient list does not specify a pasta type.

notes: Louis Howard rates the recipe 10/10 and credits @thefitnesschef_ in the description. The video alternates the source tutorial with his recreation and commentary.
The upload title says 'pheasant chicken', but the description and spoken ingredients identify chicken breast and feta. The recipe title follows the written recipe.
The spoken tutorial adds basil with the pasta; the written method tops with basil and Parmesan. Both place the basil before the final 5-minute bake.
gaps: No quantities are given for salt, black pepper, smoked paprika or basil leaves.

source.quantity_basis: All stated quantities, the 4-serving yield, 200 °C fan setting and nutrition come from the public video description. The caption transcript supplies step timestamps and both bake times. Unspecified seasoning and basil amounts remain null.
